notes.title: More characters introduced in Onimusha: Way of the Sword's latest trailer!
notes.notes:
Learn more about Miyamoto Musashi, burdened with powers he never asked for, and others he will meet on his journey, in the latest trailer for Onimusha: Way of the Sword.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword - 4th Trailer: Musashi's Story

[previewyoutube=0Wjb88AllJE;full][/previewyoutube]
Miyamoto Musashi Sets Forth, Burdened with the Power of the Oni
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/91bc6ecd8166ab42772b9252808813620a5ae18f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/36454758c1461d0eebb7fb37085682bcfda36dcd.png[/img]
Miyamoto Musashi arrives in Kyoto determined to take the next steps to master the way of the sword, and prove himself a warrior without equal. However, upon his arrival he is attacked by the Genma. Only after being granted an Oni Gauntlet and its power, does Musashi find himself able to stand against the fiends. This troubles Musashi, as to him the way of the sword is traversed on one's own strength alone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/5b76739e6f3d66ca4fce37352343e1f94489e761.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/5de11021df91dcbe64ced68fa2be8f19844ae3d2.jpg[/img]
But how can he rid himself of the Oni Gauntlet? Musashi's journey will take him on a bloody and meandering path through early Edo-period Kyoto.

Introducing Others Musashi Will Meet, and a New Genma Variant

Oni Lady (Voice: Yuriri Naka)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/fad6f0d3c7b0c699abe223e0656af050a16307d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/1d949a53d81d0e86bb93b53e42a4cce8c1d87136.jpg[/img]
A female Oni housed in Musashi's Oni Gauntlet. While she usually supports Musashi from within the gauntlet, she can also appear before him when the need arises.

Ono no Takamura (Voice: Shogo Miyakita)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/3b353fc18d6dc07b1ffcbc7a1c91b6185a91387c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/915f9e0e49fe4d6704cda70d6cb9f7b8e777fc6c.jpg[/img]
An individual that Musashi comes to meet through the guidance of the voice in his gauntlet. A highly skilled swordsman, he can vanquish Genma with ease despite his old age. He also appears to have an Oni Gauntlet, much like Musashi and Ganryu...

Izumo no Okuni (Voice: Leader Looi)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/7761e21b961ba749176a825052083f4596a9d4f5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/4ca52ba3e83eea5f677264cce46ccf6ca2644ad2.jpg[/img]
A young dancer who, due to certain circumstances, comes to Ono no Takamura seeking the power to defeat the Genma. While her Kabuki dance has brought her fame within the city, other priorities are keeping her from the stage of late.

Togemaru
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/f2c9a94597f42a359129cb05d720cd15894f05d0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/1d74fcfed1c0533e341e5c62671b2185d926e829.jpg[/img]
A Genma with large spikes running down its back. They charge forward, spinning or rolling at great speeds, to shred anyone unfortunate enough to remain in their path.

Another Location Revealed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/bb6fea660260fb72fd8e06b766783e23551d34e9.jpg[/img]
We briefly see Ono no Takamura standing over Musashi, with what appears to be giant painted screens depicting hell looming in the background. What is the significance of this mysterious place?

Notes: 
- All media depicts a game still in development.
- Some images and videos were captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.

notes.title: 📝 Weekly Oni Memo #12
notes.notes: [p]Tokyo Game Show 2025 kicks off next week! We just announced some details.[/p][p]On 9/24 at 7am PT, tune in to the TGS 2025 Capcom Online Special Program for a brand-new trailer drop![/p][p]And on 9/27 at 7:30pm PT, don’t miss our special stage event featuring voice actor Yoshimasa Hosoya as a guest, who is the JP voice for Musashi![/p][p]The stage event will also be streamed live, so if you can’t make it to the venue, be sure to catch the broadcast. (Only in Japanese)[/p][p]We’ll have 50 playable demo stations ready for TGS attendees. It will be the first time people can play the game in Japan! Just thinking about your reactions already has us nervous and excited.[/p][p]Today we have a photo of a dochu gappa, a traditional traveling raincoat in Edo-period Japan.[/p][p][/p][p]— Producer Kadowaki[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/f5efda072be03ec21c67e5b56ff9dc1b76149704.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 📝 Weekly Oni Memo #11
notes.notes:
[p]Today, let’s talk about Deflecting ememies' attacks, a move that greatly reduces the enemy’s stamina in Onimusha: Way of the Sword.[/p][p]To deflect an attack using a DualSense controller, simply hold L1 to block and press another button with the right timing. Even if you miss the timing, you will still be blocking, so you can keep trying with low risk.[/p][p]We have two control types in the game. In the aforementioned type, you deflect with an additional input while blocking, and in the alternative type, you’ll need to time a single button input instead, which makes it a little more challenging. Choose whichever style best fits your play![/p][p]I was planning to share the control guide we’ll be showing at Tokyo Game Show… but it seems I was getting ahead of myself. That’ll be revealed later![/p][p]For now, here’s a photo of a stage in the game, Dokyo's Underground Laboratory.[/p][p][/p][p]— Producer Kadowaki  
[url="https://www.e-capcom.com/sp/tgs/2025/en"]https://www.e-capcom.com/sp/tgs/2025/en[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/a948847fb147bde9f4a8b4ee3bb799e7fc5281ad.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/3aabefc0b88883aab259c0b119186933ce7e860b.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 📝Weekly Oni Memo #9
notes.notes: [p]📝Weekly Oni Memo #9[/p][p]Last week at gamescom in Germany, we had many people to play Onimusha: Way of the Sword. There were also media articles and gameplay videos released. [/p][p]The event demo was specially built to let as many people as possible experience the game, even in short sessions. The demo takes place in the main story’s Kiyomizu-dera Temple stage and is condensed to highlight its appeal. We’re showcasing it at PAX West in the U.S. [/p][p]We’re excited to have more and more players experience the game! This photo shows our Onimusha booth at gamescom—the floating souls on the left, and people waiting in line to play on the right. Because the demo shows some dismemberment, the play area was set up to be more private. [/p][p]Next up after PAX West is Tokyo Game Show, where we’ll also more new info to share! [/p][p]— Producer Kadowaki[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/ccd2ae14378c7ddb3095971e87a2074fda5117f5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New gameplay and enemies on show in Onimusha: Way of the Sword's latest trailer!
notes.notes:
[p]A new trailer for Onimusha: Way of the Sword has been released. This time we're introduced to one of the game's more strange and disturbing stages, along with Dokyo and other unique adversaries that Musashi will face when the game releases in 2026.  [/p][h2][b]Onimusha: Way of the Sword PV 3[/b] [/h2][previewyoutube="aXkU_TOx3sE;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]Introducing a Strange Location and Four New Enemies, Including Dokyo[/b] [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/f5761a19e9ec836adc4d90a1884a2dd149fc5ef4.jpg"][/img]We got our first glimpses of some new formidable foes and Genma variants. The new trailer also revealed a stage quite different from those shown until now. It appears to be some kind of foreboding laboratory, but what takes place there and what is Musashi's reason for venturing in?  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Most Sinister Individual, Dokyo (Voice: Clare Corbett) [/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/8f5320cd485e5c91e4ea32acd4294d4bc000fb88.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/1f1982b9151a47fe4fd7782b049c568a2e134d9b.jpg"][/img]An unusual entity that spends much of her time in her laboratory under the capital, engrossed in creating new Genma variants. One glimpse at the facility's eerie nature is enough to make clear her twisted tastes.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Fearsome Predator, the Greater Nue[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/f20436c93c1036a550cac2db4346644cfb3aea63.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/512a9dbdeba97df663f4e55bfe1c760faf311675.jpg"][/img]A Genma created by Dokyo. It assaults its prey with feral, agile attacks, and strikes of lightning.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Kogashira[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/86968da705ee3bf2ba1c573d8f8da8344b350a47.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/6a001f5f37620dbe722be6f9701210d54b02c91b.jpg"][/img]A parasitic Genma that puppets a human host, enhanced by the souls it has consumed. It releases Malice, which can bolster other Genma nearby.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Chijiko[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/9a1f87c2269d5a16b2de595b9fbd079cfd3ea8e7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/1a6c043e9562e735e1aa8824c520a0b4745ba99b.jpg"][/img]A Genma created by Dokyo. A grotesque mass of stitched together faces and elastic tentacles.  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Techniques that Augment the Swordplay Action[/b] [/h2][p]Here we'll cover some of the techniques Musashi will be able to employ. Feel the satisfaction of pulling off well-timed parries and deflects to negate enemy attacks, and utilize mechanics unique to the Onimusha series, such as Issen and absorbing souls.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Parry[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/6cd5efaa90f33b5f4cf124918104f17355282ccf.jpg"][/img]Redirect enemy attacks by blocking at just the right moment. The unbalanced opponent will be left open to attack briefly, and they can even be sent crashing into walls or other enemies.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Blazing State[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/93544730eb04dda6c4731da215f388421f055086.jpg"][/img]Parrying successfully enough times will trigger this state, which increases the power of Musashi's blade and generates more blue souls when landing attacks.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Deflect[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/6aec0d20135d71ea7a1cfdbc98915bec9bb39028.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/91b1f59704fc536ec90bfb77a03558b6c5dd21d7.jpg"][/img]Bounce an enemy's attack off your blade, depleting a large portion of their stamina in the process. This technique can also be used to send ranged attacks flying back at the enemies that launched them.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Absorb Souls[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/285c9962c80052075a2c7508b8704da04dc215f4.jpg"][/img]The Oni Gauntlet that Musashi has come to possess can absorb souls released by defeated enemies. Each type of soul grants a different effect.  [/p][p][b]・Soul Effects[/b][/p][p]Yellow Souls: Restore health
Blue Souls: Restore Oni Power needed for special skills
Red Souls: Experience that can be expended to unlock new abilities or upgrade equipment[/p][p]Musashi can move while absorbing souls but will be otherwise defenseless. Observing the state of the battle and deciding when to absorb souls adds another layer to the combat.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Issen[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/16f6ad9d9c114970966c3eced7da4d03b8e36b9a.jpg"][/img]A devastating critical counter-blow unleashed in the blink of an eye, and a classic Onimusha technique. Performed by pressing an attack button the moment before an enemy attack makes contact with Musashi, it is difficult to pull off. Those who succeed will be rewarded with high damage dealt to the enemy and more souls released.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]You may have noticed Musashi pull off a new technique in the trailer.[/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/b45fee11970391a8504969a60024ff409b462140.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/3c43ca3db7a481863858a8174465f5ad6603fe64.jpg"][/img]Different from his standard sword techniques, this special attack saw Musashi twirling a double-bladed weapon overheard, impacting a wide area around him.  [/p][p][/p][p]This is one of numerous special actions that can be woven into Musashi's repertoire in combat and we hope you look forward to learning more about the others in future updates.  [/p][p][/p][p]Notes:  
- All media depicts a game still in development. 
- Some images and videos were captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.  [/p][p][/p][p]Onimusha: Way of the Sword Official Website 
[url="https://www.capcom-games.com/onimusha/ws/en-us/"]https://www.capcom-games.com/onimusha/ws/en-us/[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p]Onimusha: Way of the Sword Official X (formerly Twitter) account

notes.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Is Capcom Sharpening It’s Sword
notes.notes:
During a hands-off presentation at Summer Games Fest, Onimusha: Way of the Sword quietly emerged as one of the most exciting things on the horizon. Capcom let the game speak for itself. And what it said, loud and clear, is that they’re not just reviving Onimusha to ride nostalgia. They’re rebuilding it from the hilt up.

It’s been nearly two decades since Onimusha felt like a pillar of Capcom’s portfolio. But with recent remasters and with Way of the Sword on the horizon, the studio is treating the return like an event. This isn’t a low-stakes spin-off; this is a full-scale entry with real bite, and a very clear creative vision behind it. It wears its influences proudly, particularly from samurai cinema and modern action design, but it never feels derivative.

Set in a stylized version of feudal Kyoto, the game follows Miyamoto Musashi, not the philosophical swordsman of legend, but a younger warrior modeled visually and vocally after Toshiro Mifune, a legendary Japanese... Read more

notes.title: Sasaki Ganryu enters the fray in Onimusha: Way of the Sword's latest trailer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/a16741dd16eb9a56de07613229026406d5aa0f4d.jpg[/img]

A new trailer for Onimusha: Way of the Sword has been released, giving us a glimpse of more of the action and formidable foes we can expect when the game releases in 2026. Included is our first look at Sasaki Ganryu, another samurai wielding an Oni Gauntlet.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword PV 2

[previewyoutube=-V14PfpEqA0;full][/previewyoutube]
Introducing, the fearsome rival, Sasaki Ganryu (Voice: Tashinga Bepete)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/e363d55ac8985f1d6e9560a0e2e5b76eb958db60.jpg[/img]

A swordsman, also known by the name Sasaki Kojiro. His fate seems inescapably intertwined with Musashi's. It would appear he also wields an Oni Gauntlet...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/3ca1ac24d1d94a46a1528cc9a0ce33db1924a858.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/ca7cf9a68cc4b1f2717bea4fa6c879e7928bac41.jpg[/img]
How will the clash between these two powerful warriors conclude as the story unfolds?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/1d949a53d81d0e86bb93b53e42a4cce8c1d87136.jpg[/img]
The trailer also gave us a glimpse of a mysterious woman who materializes following a dazzling burst of light from Musashi's gauntlet. Who is she, and what role does she play?

Dynamic Swordplay Action on Display
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/2eb0b06a23a95886ba85337931be74cde0d19597.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/e78774899cb8ec1f31d8404eb9ce6387f8437a05.jpg[/img]
Keen eyes likely noticed some previously unseen combat elements. The stunning Issen technique makes a return. Attack just before an enemy's strike is about to connect to unleash these satisfying and devastating counters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/245e98fecf3a04b6d065d5afb0c95cf564307ce9.jpg[/img]
A special skill utilizing a pair of ornate mallet-like weapons deals a bone crunching blow, powerful enough to send cracks through reality itself.

A New Stage and New Genma
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/f68426854e943d2eb1994d62c86997ab7decf885.jpg[/img]
In the trailer, Musashi finds himself in a fantastical space, surrounded by floating rocks and fragmented buildings, that stands in contrast to the previously shown Kyoto landmark, Kiyomizu-dera Temple. What awaits in the depths of this place?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/c682ab9894816fe3ca28e9b772b3443000e63ab4.jpg[/img]
A new path forms right before Musashi's eyes, where there was previously only a dead end. Progressing through this area will come with its own unique challenges.

An Imposing Adversary, Daidara (Voice: Abe Jarman)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/58dd649f066b8c4e155dde1cfb6b29e35fa252c8.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/815bf1bfe6087d461faf09ef173cfc1c058c7688.jpg[/img]
A towering Genma that revels in wreaking havoc with mighty swings of its intimidating club. Constantly in a state of hunger, he seeks out sustenance with an obsessive fervor.

Kubi Akari
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/01cf70e634174ec012229dabc809768caad82afd.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/06fbe320b8cd7b2f1137f1fe9447e95009306750.jpg[/img]
A strange, floating Genma variant, whose skin has a pale-bluish hue. They consume the floating souls that Musashi needs for his gauntlet, and puff up before firing blasts of energy at their prey. Despite their diminutive size, they should not be underestimated.

Notes: 
- All media depicts a game still in development.

notes.title: Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny releases today! Check out the launch trailer!
notes.notes:
The remaster of Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny is out now! Don't miss this action-packed trailer!

[previewyoutube=ltfkYKAe1G8;full][/previewyoutube]
Main Features:
- The game stars Jubei Yagyu, based on the legendary Japanese movie star Yusaku Matsuda, and has been completely revamped in high resolution!
- The smooth and satisfying hack-and-slash action from the previous game returns, with even more skills and weapons!
- The story focuses on Jubei Yagyu's quest for revenge after he awakens his Oni powers, and features branching paths determined by Jubei's bonds with his allies.
- The remaster includes new quality-of-life features like auto-saving, as well as over 100 new pieces of art and other content.

The story features a different protagonist than the first game, so you can enjoy it even if you haven't played the Onimusha: Warlords. 
Also, with the release of this new remaster, there's never been a better time to play both games! A special "Onimusha 1+2 Pack" is available for those who want to play through the series from the beginning!

notes.title: Watch the Onimusha 1+2 Trailer!
notes.notes:
We've released a new video introducing the first two Onimusha games, Onimusha: Warlords and Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny. The remastered Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny will release on May 23, 2025!

Learn more about Onimusha: Warlords, an exhilirating game set in Japan's Sengoku period featuring an epic journey battling demonic forces, and its sequel, Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny, which upped the ante with more content, deeper combat, new features, and a fresh new story.
If you're a long-time fan of the series, enjoy this trip down memory lane!
And if you're new, now's the perfect opportunity to see why the Onimusha series became such a beloved franchise!

Onimusha 1+2 Trailer

[previewyoutube=p-g_fU_b_Ko;full][/previewyoutube]
A free update is coming for Onimusha: Warlords, adding the extremely challenging "Hell" difficulty mode, and text support for 6 new languages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/3bd393f69cf2e0208c1a2faf1b45697460060ca9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/1acb45683f38e9e32ca6e55951702a1f65525e28.png[/img]
"Hell" difficulty allows you to experience the thrill of combat where getting struck by a single hit will spell your doom.
This difficulty mode is also available in Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny, so make sure you practice in Onimusha: Warlords first to hone your skills!

Update Content:
-Added New "Hell" Mode
You can now select the "Hell" difficulty from the Title Screen.
This is an extremely difficult mode where any enemy attack, no matter how light or heavy, will instantly kill you.
However, you will still be able to revive on the spot if you have a Talisman in your possession.
Note: You can earn the "Hell" Honor by completing this mode.
- Added New Languages
The following languages are now available as display languages:
Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Arabic, Latin American Spanish
Note: There are no additional voiced languages.
- Various minor functionality updates.
Note: You need an internet connection to update the game.

notes.title: Meet the hero of Onimusha: Way of the Sword in the new trailer!
notes.notes:
A brand-new trailer has been released, following up on the announcement of Onimusha: Way of the Sword in December last year.

This entry in the swordplay action series is set in an early Edo period Kyoto, twisted by the influence of the encroaching Malice. The new trailer gives us a glimpse of this title's expressive protagonist as he fights for his very life.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword - 1st Trailer: Protagonist
[previewyoutube=c0GV3CF2bp8;full][/previewyoutube]
Along with a preview of the protagonist we were also introduced to some of the enemies he will face, and how he will deal with them.

Introducing the Protagonist: Legendary Swordsman, Miyamoto Musashi (Voice: Kenichiro Thomson)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/e3257b21620f902b4308ec9d4d6617a4533cbf3a.jpg[/img]

The Onimusha series is known for casting eminent historical figures such as Samanosuke Akechi and Jubei Yagyu, widely known in Japan, as protagonists. However this time, the story will follow a legend known throughout the world. Miyamoto Musashi has been depicted in numerous forms throughout time, but Capcom is sure to put their own spin on the legendary swordsman that you won't want to miss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/922162f83e2d168f87e7b2a7fac70962c7e56632.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/a714ffabf3e36909641c58465d6332c8861c4b25.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/4b023ac603fd02c16db11781c163214d5a3b3860.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/45cc03aa5938892cfceb1978922b1b8f330c7357.jpg[/img]
Toshiro Mifune Stars as Musashi's Face Model
The protagonist of this game is a fierce young samurai, constantly moving from one bloody and gritty fight to the next. To cement this image of a striking samurai, Capcom has turned to none other than the late, iconic Japanese samurai movie legend Toshiro Mifune to star as the face model for this rendition of Miyamoto Musashi.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/3c0901d004e908ab0c132b96f400fad946492aac.jpg[/img]

Bloody Swordplay Action
The new trailer showed off some of the swordplay action you can expect to see in the battles that will unfold between the protagonist and the Genma. You'll definitely want to check out Byakue, a large and powerful enemy that wields a giant axe to great destructive effect.

・What can be gained by clashing blades...?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/458c7971f525bd81be2af951e999a1c497ddf4c3.jpg[/img]

・Make use of items in the environment, like kimono and tatami mats, to gain the upper hand in combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/198f643bee6658161279c019d4fc12be5520f2d6.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/b98c44b15a1db2ffa885e5ee7a1676df225f0c35.jpg[/img]

・Special techniques also on hand...!?
Expect to see some flashy techniques, courtesy of special weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/b248368e8a12a468caef8e39dde6b1074e5f1abe.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/8f82bc8bf66e84eae0c6fe6b121de6aaca0021fb.jpg[/img]

Genma, a Threat to Humanity
Usually found dwelling in the lowest depths of hell, the Malice enveloping Kyoto has brought these fiends into the world of the living. Their ceaseless atrocities have plunged the capital into a state of dread and panic.

Hitotsume Gasa
Capable of wielding swords, bows, and shields, these Genma tend to attack in groups. They are driven purely by their basal urges to kill and devour people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/0c26c5aff430816a1b7c70c125cadf31e0d8ea8f.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/3c0c16ea308c83e2a21f81aeba28c8a120151913.jpg[/img]

Byakue
An unfathomably strong Genma, seen giving Musashi plenty of trouble in the trailer. What was that ominous thing suspended in the air that it climbed out of...?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/e1356056bfc3187e71d1b0704177eeee86d90468.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/bc52b83641778c2638f6c5155161560637eb8911.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/6e36fb930f37630a88a6e7100cd0e601d23fa01d.jpg[/img]

Notes: 
- All media depicts a game still in development.
- Some images and videos were captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.

The development team is hard at work preparing the game for its 2026 release. Be sure to keep an eye out for future developments!

notes.notes:
The remaster of Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny, originally released in 2002, arrives on May 23, 2025. Pre-orders start today!
There are new features, exclusive bonuses, and even a pack that includes the first game, Onimusha: Warlords!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/e73a27c58faff35ea0b96ea4ab0326c819a30fe4.png[/img]

Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny 1st Trailer: Pre-Order Announcement!
[previewyoutube=8g451dVYonU;full][/previewyoutube]

Reclaim your destiny!
The tale of Jubei Yagyu's revenge returns with new features and quality-of-life improvements, while retaining the setting and gameplay systems of the original game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/aff5520081b04ca6233a7adb1e5216ea32e05257.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/d3a0847dd4b85a7440143b2f25729b092b275fe0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/efdc80248b187dfcbf4c04e464f93424fa6f9251.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/6d4cb502a48c732f62579654cfe5af7ff9c882c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/0bf180af15e42d3dbf1081478a53f0ed9e38d324.jpg[/img]
Jubei Yagyu is traveling the land to hone his skills as a samurai. One day, he hears that his home village has been attacked by a group of mysterious demons. Rushing back and witnessing the massacre left in the demons' wake, Jubei vows revenge on Nobunaga, who has been making use of the demons in his quest to conquer the country.
Having awakened to the powers of the Oni clan, Jubei sets out on a journey to find the five orbs needed to defeat Nobunaga, making allies along the way to help him in quest.

A plethora of bonuses, like the Onimusha 2: Orchestra Album Selection Pack
- Exclusive Bonuses 
If you pre-order Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny or get the Onimusha 1+2 Pack early, you'll receive the Onimusha 2: Orchestra Album Selection Pack, containing a select few tracks from the Orchestra Album, as well as a pack of useful items.

- Orchestra Album Selection
This selection contains five tracks from the Onimusha 2 Orchestra Album - Taro Iwashiro Selection, which was released in 2002 by Taro Iwashiro, the composer of Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/0934cd3a4d460c0d5ee47e36d08d83001b8c693a.png[/img]
Contents:
Truth Of Brave ～Warring Mix～
Truth Of Resolution ～Oyu's Theme～
Truth Of Edge ～Magoichi's Theme～
Truth Of Loyalty ～Ekei's Theme～
Truth Of Desire ～Kotaro's Theme～
*These songs can be accessed by selecting Special Features on the title screen and going to the Gallery.

- Item Pack
A pack containing a variety of items that will prove useful during the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/f462220211a1f77ee56376b5f759d12e06455794.jpg[/img]
Give yourself and Jubei a leg up with these extra items.

Contents:
3 herbs, 2 medicines, 1 secret medicine
2 super magic liquids, 1 perfect medicine
1 talisman, 10.000 red Souls

*These items can be obtained after meeting Takajo at the start of the game.
*These are consumable items that can also be obtained in the game.
*You can only receive the Item Pack once.

*Please visit the official website for details on the availability for each region.
*The contents of this pack are subject to change without prior notice.
*The above bonuses may be made available separately.

- Onimusha: Warlords Save Data Bonus
If you have save data for Onimusha: Warlords, you can get the Samanosuke Outfit for Jubei, based on Samanosuke Akechi, the main character of Onimusha: Warlords!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493206/0b7ca7e3a4884b437062ea88a4eff50258359287.jpg[/img]
*On Steam, you can claim this bonus if you own the main game.
*From the title screen, select Special Features, and go to "Jubei's Outfit" to change to this outfit.
*This outfit is purely cosmetic. Your stats are determined by the armor you have actually equipped.
 
On May 23, when Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny releases, we'll also release a pack with Onimusha: Warlords.
If you're new to the series, make sure to check it out!

Onimusha: Way of the Sword paints a lone samurai's desperate struggle against the eerie monsters known as the Genma, against a Kyoto setting featuring famous locations like Kiyomizu-dera Temple.
The development effort is focusing heavily on the series' signature swordplay action experience, and more information is sure to follow.

[previewyoutube=mvgPwh_oIXg;full][/previewyoutube]
Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny was first released in 2002 for the PlayStation®2.
With the protagonist Jubei Yagyu who is visually based on popular 1980s movie star Matsuda Yusaku, Onimusha 2: Samura's Destiny has slick action gameplay, and a wide cast of characters to befriend and ally with. While a worthy sequel in its own right, this game focuses on a different protagonist than Samanosuke from Onimusha: Warlords, so players can jump straight into Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny.

notes.title: Capcom announces Onimusha: Way of the Sword! Releasing worldwide 2026!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/5a6884248791cc25145c872324f66ac9ebb3c015.jpg[/img]
Get a glimpse of the thrilling and satisfying swordplay action to be found in life-or-death duels of the blade in the first trailer for the Onimusha series' newest entry, Onimusha: Way of the Sword!

[previewyoutube=KOiJGLZDnFw;full][/previewyoutube]
The 2026 worldwide release of Onimusha: Way of the Sword was announced on December 12, 2024 during the The Game Awards, the biggest game awards ceremony in the world!

Fight through bloodbaths of intense swordplay action.
Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice, where every stage is cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue.
Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight.
What fate awaits at the end of his path?

Explore an enchantingly dark setting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/f44ef7b030f31f2bb3040caeb8021255fe996689.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/6e0bda9c3235aafa1292ebe7c57dfae1d4744f67.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343632/2f4861fc3467c30ee9ff8f07a61acd97b2738ec3.jpg[/img]

About the Onimusha Series:
Debuting in 2001, the first game in the Onimusha series tells the story of a young warrior during a time of widespread war in feudal Japan. Acquiring the power of the Oni, he becomes an Onimusha and battles against the evil Genma that are attempting to conquer of the world.

The game's "Issen" critical counter action mechanic and satisfying swordplay action became defining pillars of the series.

With people and events inspired by real-life history cast into its eerie dark fantasy setting, the trials and fates of the characters painted a unique and engrossing tale that drew widespread acclaim.

Building on that success, the series has gone on to spawn numerous hit titles and even an original Netflix animation. To date the Onimusha series has sold over 8.7 million* units worldwide.

*as of September 30, 2024
